description: This file defines an abstract class 'FSDPExtensions' with methods for customizing tensor transformations in Fully Sharded Data Parallel (FSDP) training, along with utility functions to set and apply these extensions within the PyTorch distributed framework.

classes.name: FSDPExtensions
classes.description: An abstract base class providing hooks for customizing tensor operations in FSDP, including methods for tensor transformation, chunking, and gathering in distributed training.

methods.name: pre_flatten_transform
methods.description: Converts a distributed tensor to a local tensor, e.g., for flattening.

methods.name: post_unflatten_transform
methods.description: Converts a local tensor back to a distributed tensor after unflattening.

methods.name: chunk_tensor
methods.description: Splits a tensor into chunks for distributed processing.

methods.name: chunk_dtensor
methods.description: Splits a tensor or DTensor into DTensor chunks for distributed processing.

methods.name: pre_load_state_dict_transform
methods.description: Prepares a sharded tensor and its shards for loading a model state dict.

methods.name: all_gather_dtensor
methods.description: Gathers a DTensor across a device mesh for distributed training.
